messages.subject: Reactivity Bug?
parts:
Here is a really simple example and problem you can replicate: 

Toggle the second radio group, and you'll see the return()'d string does not update.  But if you toggle the first radio group, the string does update, and right after that toggle the second group and you'll see the string updates again.  

Why doesn't the string always update when I toggle the second (or third) radio groups.  It requires the first one be toggled first.  Is this a reactivity bug?



ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Test"),
  sidebarPanel(
    radioButtons("channel.label","Show channel label",c("Yes","No"),selected="No"),
    radioButtons("video.label","Show video label",c("Yes","No"),selected="No"), 
    radioButtons("video.model", "Modeling",c("Yes","No"),selected="No")    
  ),
  mainPanel(    
    textOutput("one")    
  )
))

server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  output$one <- renderText({    
    return(paste(input$channel.label, input$video.label, input$video.model))
  })
  })

messages.subject: Re: Reactivity Bug?
parts: Replace the periods from the IDs and replace them with, say, underscores and it should work. Unfortunately Shiny doesn't currently warn you, but periods aren't valid characters in input/output IDs.
